title: Contact Us
description: Get in touch with the AI Tool Scout editorial team — corrections, partnership enquiries, tool submissions or general questions.
html:
Corrections, suggestions, tool submissions or partnership enquiries — we read everything.

Ways to reach us

✉

General & editorial

Questions about an article, a correction, or something we got wrong.

hello@aitoolscout.com

◆

Tool submissions

Build an AI tool? Send it over. Every submission is reviewed before it is considered — and we never charge for coverage.

submissions@aitoolscout.com

◈

Partnerships

Sponsored content and advertising enquiries. All partnerships are labelled as such and never buy editorial placement.

partners@aitoolscout.com

◐

Response time

We aim to reply to all editorial messages within two business days. Partnership enquiries may take longer.

Mon–Fri

Send a message

We only use this to reply to you.

Prefer email? Write to hello@aitoolscout.com directly.

Reporting a correction

Please include the article URL, the paragraph in question, and a source for the correct information. Corrections are verified before we update an article, and we publish what changed.
